sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, though they'll face a struggling Alsager side who have won just once all season and arrive in poor form.
divisionWide: The chasing pack includes second-placed Stafford Town, who travel to Dawley Town on Saturday—both sides searching for wins after recent losses. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd) host Eccleshall (5th) in an intriguing mid-table clash between teams in contrasting form: Bridgnorth have won their last three before consecutive defeats, while Eccleshall have found consistency with four wins in their last six. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, welcome Wednesfield Community to a local derby on Saturday before hosting Brereton Social on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town (6th, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir in a fixture between teams separated by just one point. Barnton host Shawbury United—a contest between sides with markedly different trajectories, as Shawbury continue a devastating run of six straight losses. New Mills welcome Market Drayton Town in a battle between 8th and 10th. Crewe face Allscott Heath on Saturday, while Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement-area encounter. Brereton Social begin their weekend at home to Widnes Town (bottom, pointless in recent matches), before their midweek trip to face Wednesfield Community.
